# Pomah Guesthouse

> Pomah Guesthouse is a family-friendly guesthouse in Semarang, Central Java, Indonesia. "Pomah" means "Home" in Javanese — the property is built around warmth, comfort, and personal hospitality. It offers rooms ranging from standard stays to private-pool villas, a local-attractions guide for Semarang, WhatsApp booking assistance, and an AI chat concierge.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://pomahguesthouse.com/): Overview of the property, featured rooms, facilities, and current promotions.
- [Rooms](https://pomahguesthouse.com/rooms/): Browse all available room types with photos, amenities, capacity, and pricing in IDR.
- [Book a Room](https://pomahguesthouse.com/bookings): Check availability and make a reservation directly on-site.
- [Explore Semarang](https://pomahguesthouse.com/explore-semarang): Curated guide to nearby attractions, city events, and activities within the Semarang area.
- [Chat / Concierge](https://pomahguesthouse.com/chat): AI-powered guest assistant for questions about rooms, rates, check-in, and local recommendations.

## Property details

- **Location:** Tembalang district, Semarang, Jawa Tengah (Central Java), Indonesia — near Universitas Diponegoro (UNDIP).
- **Check-in / Check-out:** 14:00 / 12:00
- **Reception hours:** 07:00–22:00
- **Currency:** IDR (Indonesian Rupiah)
- **Contact:** info@pomahguesthouse.com · reservations@pomahguesthouse.com · WhatsApp available

## Room types (examples)

- **Deluxe Room** — king bed, AC, smart TV, private balcony, garden view; from IDR 1,500,000/night (2 guests, ~50 m²)
- **Private Pool Villa** — king bed, private pool, kitchenette, butler service; from IDR 3,500,000/night (4 guests, ~120 m²)

## About the name

"Pomah" (ꦥꦺꦴꦩꦃ) is Javanese for "home." The guesthouse takes its name and ethos from that word — guests are welcomed as family, not customers.
